items.headline: Federal judge rules Trump administration's deportation push against pro-Palestinian students unconstitutional
items.summary: A U.S. district judge ruled that the Trump administration violated international students' constitutional rights by revoking their visas and pursuing deportation over pro-Palestinian speech. The judge wrote that freedom of speech belongs to the people, not the government.
items.why_it_matters: The ruling reaffirms that free speech and due process protections extend to noncitizens and pushes back against using immigration law to punish political expression.
